title: Minimum Earned Share Waiver for Long-Held Excess Flood Policies Sold Mid-Term
content:
**Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines).** On a sale cancellation, a policy renewed several times keeps a reduced minimum earned share, or none.

**Clause.** The minimum earned share on a sale cancellation is nothing where three or more renewal term premiums are booked on this policy and no claim payment on this policy was issued in the 12 whole months before the cancellation is signed, 10 percent where three or more renewal term premiums are booked and such a claim payment was issued in those 12 months. In every other case this waiver does not apply.

A renewal term premium booked is a term premium item booked on this policy's premium account on a renewal. A claim payment counts when it was issued on this excess policy fewer than 12 whole months before the day the cancellation is signed.

| Renewal term premiums booked | Claim payment on this policy in the 12 whole months before signing | Minimum earned share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | none | nothing |
| 3 or more | one or more | 10 percent |
| 2 or fewer | either | not waived |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** With 3 renewal term premiums booked and the last claim payment issued 12 whole months before the cancellation is signed, no payment falls in the window and the share is nothing; with the payment 11 whole months before, the share is 10 percent.
